senses.gloss:
(इ,) पिडि r. 1st and 10th cls. (पिण्डति-ते पिण्डयति)
To accumulate, to assemble, to heap together.

(ऋ) पीडृ r. 10th cl. (पीडयति)
1 To give pain.
2 To oppose or resist.
3 To stir, to agitate.
4 To squeeze or pinch.

f. (-डा)
1 Pain, anguish, suffering.
2 Compassion, charity, pity.
3 Devastation, laying waste.
4 A chaplet, a garland for the head.
5 The Saral tree, (Pinus longifolia.)
E.
पीड to pain, अङ् and टाप् affs.

mf. (-कः-का)
A small boil, a pimple.

n. (-नं)
1 Inflicting pain, paining, distressing.
2 Devastation, laying a country waste.
3 Squeezing, pressing, rubbing.
E.
पीड to give pain, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Giving pain, afflicting, tormenting.
E.
पीडा, and कर who makes.

n. (-णं)
Torturing, tormenting.
E.
पीडा, and करण making.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Bound, tied.
2 Pained, suffering pain or distress.
3 Laid waste, destroyed, devastated.
4 Rubbed, chafed.
5 Squeezed, pressed.
E.
पीडा pain, इतच् aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Being pained or afflicted.
2 Suffering from.
3 Being squeezed or pressed.
E.
पीड to pain, pass. v., शानच् aff.
